worldcombat.skill.steelroller.summary: Crush the terrain under you and roll out as a steel wheel; with no active terrain underfoot the whole move fails and its PP is still spent.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.use.0: Crush the terrain underfoot and roll through
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.use.1: Trade a patch of terrain for one heavy hit
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.use.2: Carve a drivable steel furrow across the battlefield
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.descriptio: The wheel deals about %1$s physical damage and rolls up to %2$s blocks. It can only be used while standing on an active terrain, which it crushes entirely; with no terrain underfoot the whole move fails and its PP is still spent.

It rolls %1$s blocks per tick with a %2$s-block hit radius; the first enemy in its path is struck and knocked back %3$s blocks, ending the roll. The ground behind is pressed into %4$s furrow blocks that linger %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.grind.on: Grind on: power +18% and a longer, longer-lived furrow, but shorter roll (distance x0.8), speed x0.9, recovery +5 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.grind.off: Grind off: a cruise, rolling farther and faster and recovering cleanly, at slightly lower power.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; %2$s after starting it spends %4$s PP; recovery %3$s, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.growth.0: At level %1$s the impact rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.growth.1: At level %1$s the impact rises to %2$s and the roll reaches %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.steelroller.preference: On: power +18% and a longer, longer-lived furrow, but a shorter roll (distance x0.8), speed x0.9, recovery +5 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks. Off: a cruise, rolling farther and faster and recovering cleanly, at slightly lower power.
Only roll when the target is this close; the roll distance is moderate, so a larger value often still cannot reach.
